Our Competitive Advantage

Why Global Importers Partner With Us

Over two decades of precision processing, transparent pricing, and punctual maritime dispatch.

Direct Himalayan Farmer Sourcing

Contract farming partnerships across Punjab and Haryana ensuring 100% authentic seed pedigree, non-GMO cultivation, and complete traceability from field to bag.

State-of-the-Art Optical Sortex

Multi-stage Buhler Sortex optical color sorters, advanced destoners, metal detectors, and computer-controlled parboiling plants yielding uniform grain color and zero foreign matter.

Private Label & Custom Packaging

Complete OEM packaging in BOPP bags, Non-Woven sacks, Jute bags, and premium retail pouches (1kg to 50kg) custom printed with buyer’s private brand, logos, and regional nutrition labeling.

Strict Laboratory QA & SGS Inspection

Every consignment is analyzed in our in-house lab for grain elongation, moisture, and cooking test. Verified by independent global inspectors (SGS, Bureau Veritas, Intertek) prior to container sealing.

Strategic Port Operations (Mundra & JNPT)

Dedicated CFS warehousing at Mundra Port and Nhava Sheva (Mumbai). Fast customs clearance, vessel stuffing, and prioritized shipping lines (Maersk, MSC, CMA CGM) ensuring minimal transit delays.

Flexible IncoTerms & Trade Finance

FOB, CIF, and CFR trade execution. Support for international payment instruments including Irrevocable Letters of Credit (LC at Sight), CAD via prime banks, and Wire Transfer (T/T).

Worldwide Maritime Network

Exporting to 45+ Ports Worldwide

ARROW ARO RICE maintains continuous sea route dispatches to key consumer and distribution hubs across the Middle East, Europe, North America, Africa, and Southeast Asia.

Jebel Ali (Dubai), Jeddah Islamic Port, Dammam, Shuwaikh (Kuwait), Hamad Port (Qatar), Muscat (Oman)
